directorStatement.audienceFeeling: The audience sees the fun leave the room before Sunny does: children feel the muddy, sticky party stop being funny, while adults feel the cost of managing joy instead of sharing it.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Sunny owns the scene. Her want is to restore the exact party in her head; what she conceals is embarrassment that the rain has beaten her plan. The visible change is her bright command-mask finally dropping when she actually registers her friends’ faces.
directorStatement.theLaugh: Escalating overcommitment. Every fix Sunny makes must physically worsen the cave: saving decorations creates indoor rain, denying puddles creates more puddle play, forcing fun turns honey into a dance disaster. The drama is that her energy keeps outrunning her care.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: Sunny bursts into the party cave clutching soaked decorations, water trailing behind her, already pointing urgently to where lanterns and ribbons must go before anyone has dried off. -> Sunny stands among the ruined party pieces, her pendant dim, facing wet, muddy, sticky friends who are no longer performing fun for her.
directorStatement.carryForward: Sunny is exposed rather than fixed: her pendant is dim and she has finally asked the question the room has already answered.

northStar.surfaceStory: Sunny tries to rescue a rained-out outdoor party by rebuilding it inside the cave, but every urgent fix makes the room wetter, stickier and less fun.
northStar.universalTruth: When we are scared our special day is ruined, we can start managing the people we love instead of being with them.
northStar.childClearWant: Sunny wants the cave party to look perfect and sunny again, right now.
northStar.emotionalNeed: Sunny needs to notice her friends’ real faces instead of chasing the picture in her head.
northStar.falseBeliefUnderPressure: If the decorations look perfect, everyone will be happy; if they get muddy, the party is ruined.
northStar.relationshipEngine: Her friends keep offering help, comfort and play; Sunny keeps converting their care into tasks until their silent, messy faces finally show her the cost.
northStar.ordinaryLifeTruth: A parent or child trying to save a celebration can accidentally squeeze all the joy out of it.
northStar.sceneTurn: After the forced honey dance crashes and Fuzzby collapses sticky, the cave goes quiet; Sunny’s performance smile cannot survive everyone looking wet, muddy and done.
audienceJourney: amused by helpers scrambling in the cave
nervous-funny as every rescue makes more mess
laughing at the honey-pot chaos and forced party song
quieting when the room stops playing along
softly sorry for Sunny as her pendant dims
northStar.finalAfterFeeling: Not fixed; exposed. Sunny has not learned to love the mess yet, but she can no longer pretend perfection is working.
northStar.dialogueSubtractionOpportunity: Do not add explanations of Sunny’s panic or anyone’s disappointment. The refused towel, rushed hands, slipping bodies, sticky helmet, silent faces and dim pendant carry the truth. Keep the locked lines, but let the final question land after the room has already answered it visually.
northStar.environmentPressure: The cave is shelter but not relief: dripping garlands, muddy water, slick stone, cramped party objects, a wobbling stool, lantern, cushions and honey pot physically turn Sunny’s control into chaos.

transformation.entryBelief: A good party is the one I planned; my friends need me to restore it exactly.
transformation.entryFeeling: Soaked, embarrassed and frantic under a bright hostess mask.
transformation.pressureBehaviour: She refuses drying off, issues instructions, grabs props and turns accidents into louder pretend-fun before anyone can admit it is going wrong.
transformation.costlyChoice: She stops selling the party for one beat and actually looks at her friends’ wet, muddy, sticky faces.
transformation.exitBelief: My perfect party is not making them happy; I may be the one making this worse.
transformation.exitAction: Her fake smile drops, her pendant dims, and she asks the room if they are not having a good time.

tapestry.physicalMotif: Soaked paper decorations: first treated as precious things to save, then becoming the dripping, splatting proof that Sunny’s perfect picture cannot survive contact with real play.
tapestry.sonicMotif: Rain drip and cave plip become indoor percussion, escalating into splats, squeaks, BUZZ-CRASH, then a small silence under Sunny’s final line.
tapestry.colourAndLightProgression: Begin with attempted warm party glow against grey rainwater; grow muddier and stickier as lantern light wobbles; end with the warmth dulled and Sunny’s pendant dim rather than triumphant.
tapestry.thematicVisualContrast: Sunny’s fast, busy brightness versus friends who are trying to help, dry off, splash, laugh or simply survive the mess. The cave should feel increasingly full while Sunny feels increasingly alone in the centre of her own party.
tapestry.openingClosingRhyme: Open on Sunny bursting in clutching wet party pieces as if she can still save the day; close on Sunny facing the same ruined party materials now spread across her friends, finally seeing they were never just decorations.

creativeIntent.selectedTreatment: The Room Answers Before Sunny Does — with the environmental chain pressure of The Cave Throws the Party Back and the tightening Sunny-proximity of Sunny’s Hostess Tunnel
creativeIntent.governingAudienceExperience: The audience sees the fun leave the room before Sunny does: children feel the muddy, sticky party stop being funny, while adults feel the cost of managing joy instead of sharing it.
creativeIntent.scenePurpose: Sunny tries to restore her planned perfect party inside the cave, but the cave and her friends’ faces reveal that her controlling rescue is squeezing the fun out of the room.
creativeIntent.emotionalPointOfView: Sunny owns the scene. Her want is to restore the exact party in her head; what she conceals is embarrassment that the rain has beaten her plan. The visible change is her bright command-mask finally dropping when she actually registers her friends’ faces.
creativeIntent.comicOrDramaticMechanism: Escalating overcommitment. Every fix Sunny makes must physically worsen the cave: saving decorations creates indoor rain, denying puddles creates more puddle play, forcing fun turns honey into a dance disaster. The drama is that her energy keeps outrunning her care.
creativeIntent.characterPerformanceStrategy: Sunny performs brightness as speed: quick hands, lifted voice, too-wide smile, no time to receive comfort. Amie’s towel offer is small and careful. Keen tries to soften the room, then adapts into puddle play. Fuzzby commits fully to indignation once honeyed. Zenny nearly holds composure, and the tiny break matters because she is usually still. The friends’ performances gradually lose bounce until silence becomes the answer before Sunny’s final line.
creativeIntent.visualGrammar: Compressed, close, busy compositions that make the cave feel smaller as Sunny tries harder. Warm party light is always present but increasingly dulled by grey rainwater, mud, and sticky honey. Frames should let ruined decorations cross faces and block paths so Sunny’s perfect picture visibly interferes with connection.
creativeIntent.cameraCharacterRelationship: The camera keeps near Sunny’s working space, often discovering consequences as she does rather than waiting safely for them. It starts as her ally, racing with her instructions, then slowly becomes less obedient: it lingers on the friends she is not seeing until her point of view is forced to include them.
creativeIntent.movementVersusStillness: Sunny is almost always moving until the crash. The friends begin helpful and mobile, then settle into wetter, stickier stillness. The turn is created by movement draining out of the room; Sunny’s final look should feel like the first time the scene has stopped breathing with her.
creativeIntent.depthAndEnvironment: Foreground clutter increases: wet ribbons, lanterns, ladder, stool, cushions, honey pot. Depth should stack the friends at different distances so Sunny’s final realization is not one reaction but a roomful of evidence. The cave walls and dripping ceiling press inward as the mess spreads.
creativeIntent.rhythmAndEscalation: Begin with fast instruction and rescue energy. Let each accident land with a clear physical consequence before Sunny immediately tries to rename it as fun. The forced honey dance is the peak: song, slide, smash, then a hard drop into quiet. Sunny’s last line needs the room’s silence underneath it.
creativeIntent.cutPhilosophy: Cuts are motivated by Sunny’s attention failing: from her task to the consequence she caused, from her forced cheer to the friend absorbing it. No automatic reaction pattern; hold longer only when the room is teaching Sunny something she has avoided seeing.
creativeIntent.openingImage: Sunny bursts into the party cave clutching soaked decorations, water trailing behind her, already pointing urgently to where lanterns and ribbons must go before anyone has dried off.
creativeIntent.closingImage: Sunny stands among the ruined party pieces, her pendant dim, facing wet, muddy, sticky friends who are no longer performing fun for her.
creativeIntent.handoverToNextScene: Sunny is exposed rather than fixed: her pendant is dim and she has finally asked the question the room has already answered.
creativeIntent.intendedFinalFeeling: Warm, giggly release: the day is still wet and imperfect, but Sunny is no longer carrying the party alone.

emotion.entryState: Soaked, embarrassed and trying to look in charge.
emotion.pressure: The outdoor party has been rained on and the paper decorations are threatened by mud.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She chooses command-speed instead of receiving help.
emotion.exitState: Still bright, but more frantic; the cave is now full of wet party materials.
emotion.observableEvidence: She clutches soaked decorations, points urgently and speaks in rapid instructions while water trails behind her.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The decorations are saved only by making the cave wetter and tighter.

comedy.setup: Sunny treats an indoor rescue as if speed can outrun rain.
comedy.expectation: The helpers will make the party safer.
comedy.disruption: Her entrance brings the rain inside with her.
comedy.button: The pretty paper is protected by being dragged dripping into the cave.
comedy.hold: Hold just long enough for the water trail to register under her confident orders.

emotion.entryState: Bright mask working hard; unwilling to be seen as defeated.
emotion.pressure: Amie’s towel and Keen’s line invite her to stop performing control.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She rejects comfort and chooses to make her own sunshine.
emotion.exitState: More determined and less available to her friends.
emotion.observableEvidence: She does not take the towel; her attention jumps to the ladder and decorations.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The audience can see her friends are already offering what she needs, but she cannot receive it.

comedy.setup: A soaked host is offered the obvious first fix: dry off.
comedy.expectation: She will accept the towel or at least slow down.
comedy.disruption: She rejects drying because it does not fit the perfect-party rescue fantasy.
comedy.button: She announces she will make indoor sunshine in a wet cave.
comedy.hold: Let Keen’s sincere line sit for half a beat before Sunny swerves away from it.

emotion.entryState: Determined to make the cave look sunny.
emotion.pressure: The garland physically proves her fix is making the problem worse.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She names the wetness as disaster instead of accepting Keen’s playful reframing.
emotion.exitState: More controlling and more visibly rattled.
emotion.observableEvidence: She throws her hands up, releases the garland, and recoils from muddy puddles as if they threaten the whole party.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The audience has seen a possible fun version of the party, and Sunny has rejected it.

comedy.setup: Sunny tries to hang sunshine using soaking decorations.
comedy.disruption: They drip on Keen, then fall and make a puddle he wants to enjoy.
comedy.button: Sunny treats muddy puddles as an emergency at a party already inside because of rain.
comedy.hold: Hold on Keen’s toes in the splash before Sunny’s horror cuts off the fun.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: The soaked garland remains visible from Sunny’s paws to the floor so the drip, release and splat read as one cause-and-effect chain.
physicalStaging.contactAndWeight: The garland hangs heavy with water, sags, slips from Sunny’s grip, lands flat with a wet slap and pushes muddy water outward onto Keen’s toes.
physicalStaging.payoffShape: A neat decoration becomes an ugly puddle exactly where Keen can splash.
prohibitedStaging: Do not hide the garland’s fall behind bodies.
Do not make the splash dry or weightless.
Do not let Keen already be splashing before the water hits.

emotion.pressure: Her movement triggers objects and friends in sequence.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She does not yet stop; the room’s chaos outruns her attention.
emotion.exitState: Still trying to manage the party, with bigger evidence she is causing harm.
emotion.observableEvidence: The chain reaction crosses the cave while Sunny remains in rescue mode.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: Fuzzby is sticky and blinded; the party has become something friends must survive.

comedy.setup: A honey pot is part of the crowded party clutter.
comedy.expectation: The domino chain will make a mess around the bears.
comedy.disruption: The pot lands over Fuzzby like a sticky helmet.
comedy.button: Fuzzby indignantly declares the condition as if it is an official injury.
comedy.hold: Hold on Zenny’s almost-still face until the tiny laugh escapes, then let Fuzzby claim the button.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: Each domino contact must be readable in order: lantern to stool, stool to Howey, Howey into Misty, Misty into honey pot, honey pot onto Fuzzby.
physicalStaging.contactAndWeight: Objects shove and wobble with wet-floor momentum; the honey pot has enough weight to drop over Fuzzby and enough stickiness to slow his angry waddle.
physicalStaging.payoffShape: A clean party prop becomes a helmet that turns Fuzzby’s pride into blind, sticky indignation.
prohibitedStaging: Do not teleport the honey pot onto Fuzzby without the chain.
Do not let the pot look weightless.
Do not overplay Zenny; her tiny break is the joke.

emotion.entryState: Desperate to reframe disaster as fun.
emotion.pressure: Everyone is watching her latest failure and Fuzzby is visibly stuck.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She chooses performance over stopping, turning the rescue into a forced dance.
emotion.exitState: Her hostess mask is still up, but it is cracking under the room’s lack of response.
emotion.observableEvidence: She sings, spins, crashes, then presents the wreckage with a question that needs approval.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The audience knows the party has stopped being fun before Sunny can admit it.

comedy.setup: Sunny sees everyone watching and cannot allow the honey accident to be failure.
comedy.expectation: She will help Fuzzby get free.
comedy.disruption: She turns him into a dance partner and makes the honey problem mobile.
comedy.button: Fuzzby collapses the performance with “I’m too sticky for this!”
comedy.hold: After the crash, let Sunny’s ta-da hang in the room before Fuzzby’s sticky refusal lands.

physicalStaging.staysVisible: Sunny, Fuzzby, the honey pot, wet floor path and cushion pile stay readable so the song, slide and crash form one chain.
physicalStaging.contactAndWeight: Sunny’s grip on Fuzzby pulls against sticky resistance; their combined momentum skids on water and stops heavily in the cushions, which compress and settle.
physicalStaging.payoffShape: A party dance becomes an uncontrolled honey-slick slide into a soft but decisive crash.
prohibitedStaging: Do not make Fuzzby seem like a willing dance partner.
Do not cut away before the slide route is clear.
Do not let the crash erase the sticky aftermath.

emotion.entryState: Still trying to hold a ta-da smile after the crash.
emotion.pressure: No one answers with fun; the room is silent and messy.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She stops selling the party and actually looks at her friends’ faces.
emotion.exitState: Soft, ashamed and newly honest; her perfect-party belief has cracked.
emotion.observableEvidence: Her smile drops, her movement stops, her pendant dims, and her eyes move from face to face before the line.
emotion.heldAfterBeat: The ache remains visible in the ruined party pieces and friends who are not yet cheered up.

comedy.mechanism: None; the beat deliberately releases comedy into quiet consequence.
comedy.setup: The crash has ended the forced fun.
comedy.expectation: Sunny’s ta-da might keep the party pretending alive.
comedy.disruption: The room does not perform fun back to her.
comedy.button: No joke button; the final line is an admission, not a gag.
comedy.hold: Hold the silence before and after the line so the faces answer first.

shots.purpose: Launch Sunny's hostess tunnel: speed, help, comfort and truth all get converted into the perfect-party plan.
shots.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Sunny Sunny bursts in soaked with decorations clutched high, water trailing behind her as her pointing paw is already assigning directions; action: Amie Amie steps into Sunny’s route and offers a dry towel at small-body height, holding it steady rather than pushing it forward; reaction: Keen Keen pauses with the ladder, shoulders open toward Sunny, then holds his position long enough for his care to read; settle: Sunny Sunny turns away from the towel and Keen, grips the wet garland, and fixes her attention on the cave wall. Cause and effect: Sunny’s wet entrance brings water and clutter into the cave; decorations pass into helper paws; Amie’s towel interrupts the traffic but Sunny’s body bypasses it; Keen’s ladder becomes the next working object. Visible turn: Sunny changes from emergency helper to controller: her smile stays bright, but her body stops receiving comfort and aims fully at construction. Land on: Sunny must end beside the ladder with wet garland in paw, towel unaccepted behind her, and helpers mobilized as crew. Acting freedom: Keep exact prop handoffs and refusal clear, but allow natural paw adjustments, drips, helper glances and tiny balance corrections.

voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: Sunny, it’s okay. We are safe inside now. Let’s just dry off.

voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Careful concern, towel offered as comfort not correction.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Still gentle, leaving space for Sunny to refuse.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Slow and low compared with Sunny; each phrase is a hand held out.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Three soft steps: name, reassurance, practical invitation.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Small pause after “okay” to let the towel register.
voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Settled breath before “Sunny”; warm exhale into “dry off.”

voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [nervous] No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!

voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice dodges the towel exactly as the body does: no softness allowed in.

voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Threatened by softness.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Recommitted to action, tighter than before.

voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Deflection, impossible standard, sharp delegation.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Hard turn before “Keen” as she redirects away from Amie’s care.
voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Thin inhale before “We must”; clipped breath before “Keen.”

voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Keen
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [quietly] We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Protected hold after ladder steadies; about 3.0s.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice supports Keen’s stillness; he becomes a safe anchor in the room.
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Offer Sunny a smaller, kinder definition of success.
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: Please come back to us; we are already here.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Gentle concern while steadying the ladder.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Hopeful, but aware she may not accept it.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Unhurried, grounded, a clear contrast to Sunny.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Simple and balanced; the second sentence lands softer.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Brief pause after “Sunny” to let the thought reach her.
voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Calm breath before speaking; no rush to fill the silence.

voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: But I want it to be perfect! Well, I’ll make my own sunshine in here! Just watch!

voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: After Keen’s stillness has landed; about 4.0s, ending on forward action.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice reveals the crack under the wide smile, then snaps back into motion.

shots.purpose: Turn the first fix into visible proof that Sunny is making the party wetter and less free.
shots.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: ENVIRONMENT The soaked garland sags against the cave wall; drops gather, fall, and mark the floor beneath it; action: Sunny Sunny’s paws tense, then release the garland; it falls flat and pushes muddy water outward onto Keen’s toes; reaction: Keen Keen looks down, wiggles his toes in the new puddle and gives one happy stomp that sends a small splash up; settle: Sunny Sunny recoils from the splash area, face tightening as she stands between wet ribbons and the fallen garland. Cause and effect: Water weight makes the garland sag and drip; Sunny’s release turns the overhead drip into a floor impact; the impact spreads muddy water to Keen; Keen’s stomp proves the puddle can become play; Sunny’s recoil stops that possibility. Visible turn: The room briefly opens into fun through Keen, then narrows again when Sunny treats the same water as a threat to her plan. Land on: The fallen garland, active muddy puddle, stalled Keen and tightened Sunny must all remain visible as the handoff to her next rush. Acting freedom: Let the drip rhythm, splash height and Keen’s toe wiggle vary, but preserve the cause chain from sag to drop to splash to Sunny’s recoil.
shots.camera: Keep the garland, drip, fall, splash and puddle in readable cause-and-effect; make the frame tighten only when Sunny refuses Keen's play.

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: Oh… no sunshine today? Just a drop? Instead of calming down, Sunny throws her hands in the air.
dialogueLines.delivery: Oh… no sunshine today? Just a drop? Instead of calming down, Sunny throws her hands in the air.

dialogueLines.speaker: Sunny
dialogueLines.exactText: Oh no! I’m making it rain inside! The party is getting wetter, not better! She lets go of the wet garland. It falls to the cave floor with a giant SPLAT! Muddy water splashes all over Keen’s toes.
dialogueLines.delivery: [gasps] Oh no! I’m making it rain inside! The party is getting wetter, not better! She lets go of the wet garland. It falls to the cave floor with a giant SPLAT! Muddy water splashes all over Keen’s toes.

dialogueLines.speaker: Misty
dialogueLines.exactText: Sunny, wait, it’s just a little water —
dialogueLines.delivery: [quietly] Sunny, wait, it’s just a little water —

dialogueLines.speaker: Keen
dialogueLines.exactText: Actually… don’t worry! I love to splash in muddy puddles!
dialogueLines.delivery: Actually… don’t worry! I love to splash in muddy puddles!

dialogueLines.speaker: Sunny
dialogueLines.exactText: Muddy puddles?! At a perfect party?! No, no, no!
dialogueLines.delivery: [nervous] Muddy puddles?! At a perfect party?! No, no, no!

voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [nervous] No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!

voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Reject comfort and recruit Keen into her rescue plan.
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: If we stop, I’ll have to feel how wrong this is going.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Threatened by softness.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Recommitted to action, tighter than before.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Fast, brittle, with the middle phrase pushed too hard.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Deflection, impossible standard, sharp delegation.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Hard turn before “Keen” as she redirects away from Amie’s care.
voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Thin inhale before “We must”; clipped breath before “Keen.”

voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Keen
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [quietly] We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Protected hold after ladder steadies; about 3.0s.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice supports Keen’s stillness; he becomes a safe anchor in the room.
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Offer Sunny a smaller, kinder definition of success.

voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Gentle concern while steadying the ladder.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Hopeful, but aware she may not accept it.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Unhurried, grounded, a clear contrast to Sunny.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Simple and balanced; the second sentence lands softer.

voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: But I want it to be perfect! Well, I’ll make my own sunshine in here! Just watch!

voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: After Keen’s stillness has landed; about 4.0s, ending on forward action.

_world.cameraLanguage: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.
_world.lightBaseline: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

invariants: Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

invariants: Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

geography: Fixed party geography: foreground party table with berry cups and napkins; Sunny crosses the midground; hanging garland and lanterns occupy the background; preserve the established table-side axis and layered depth across every cut.
invariants: Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

requirements.requiredText: Launch Sunny's hostess tunnel: speed, help, comfort and truth all get converted into the perfect-party plan.

Performance phases: anticipation: Sunny Sunny bursts in soaked with decorations clutched high, water trailing behind her as her pointing paw is already assigning directions; action: Amie Amie steps into Sunny’s route and offers a dry towel at small-body height, holding it steady rather than pushing it forward; reaction: Keen Keen pauses with the ladder, shoulders open toward Sunny, then holds his position long enough for his care to read; settle: Sunny Sunny turns away from the towel and Keen, grips the wet garland, and fixes her attention on the cave wall. Cause and effect: Sunny’s wet entrance brings water and clutter into the cave; decorations pass into helper paws; Amie’s towel interrupts the traffic but Sunny’s body bypasses it; Keen’s ladder becomes the next working object. Visible turn: Sunny changes from emergency helper to controller: her smile stays bright, but her body stops receiving comfort and aims fully at construction. Land on: Sunny must end beside the ladder with wet garland in paw, towel unaccepted behind her, and helpers mobilized as crew. Acting freedom: Keep exact prop handoffs and refusal clear, but allow natural paw adjustments, drips, helper glances and tiny balance corrections.
Keep the camera close to Sunny's wet working space; let soaked decorations, towel, ladder and helper paws crowd faces as her speed converts care into tasks.

Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. intendedPlan.landing: Sunny must end beside the ladder with wet garland in paw, towel unaccepted behind her, and helpers mobilized as crew.
geography: Fixed party geography: foreground party table with berry cups and napkins; Sunny crosses the midground; hanging garland and lanterns occupy the background; preserve the established table-side axis and layered depth across every cut.
invariants: Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

Preserve the approved look, fixed set geography, interaction axis and story time across cuts. Character and movable-prop positions follow the directed actions and end states.
Fixed party geography: foreground party table with berry cups and napkins; Sunny crosses the midground; hanging garland and lanterns occupy the background; preserve the established table-side axis and layered depth across every cut.
Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.
Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

_world.cameraLanguage: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.
_world.lightBaseline: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.
Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: More frantic, still hiding panic behind command energy.
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: Lanterns over here! Ribbons over there! Hurry, before the pretty paper gets muddy!
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Begin after skid is readable, not on frame one; about 2.5–3.0s, overlapping task handoffs.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Very fast, command-before-breath energy; not shouted at the audience, aimed at nearby helpers.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Tiny reset after each exclamation only long enough to point; no comfortable pause.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice matches the rushing body: brightness used as speed and control.
voiceDirectorBrief.relationshipTarget: The whole room, especially any helper reaching to comfort her.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Clipped list rhythm that tumbles forward; final phrase tightens.
voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: If I keep smiling and assigning jobs, the storm cannot win.

voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Settled breath before “Sunny”; warm exhale into “dry off.”
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Slow Sunny down without embarrassing her.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [quietly] Sunny, it’s okay. We are safe inside now. Let’s just dry off.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Careful concern, towel offered as comfort not correction.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Still gentle, leaving space for Sunny to refuse.
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: Sunny, it’s okay. We are safe inside now. Let’s just dry off.
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: After Sunny’s first command burst; about 3.0s with a soft hold on the towel.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Slow and low compared with Sunny; each phrase is a hand held out.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Small pause after “okay” to let the towel register.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice creates the protected hold around the towel, countering Sunny’s rush.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Three soft steps: name, reassurance, practical invitation.
voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Amie
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: I can see you are frightened, and I am offering you a soft landing.

voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Thin inhale before “We must”; clipped breath before “Keen.”
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Reject comfort and recruit Keen into her rescue plan.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [nervous] No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Threatened by softness.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Recommitted to action, tighter than before.
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: No time for drying! We must make the inside look exactly like the outside! Keen, bring the ladder!
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Starts as she slips past the towel; about 3.5s, accelerating into “ladder.”
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Fast, brittle, with the middle phrase pushed too hard.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Hard turn before “Keen” as she redirects away from Amie’s care.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice dodges the towel exactly as the body does: no softness allowed in.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Deflection, impossible standard, sharp delegation.
voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: If we stop, I’ll have to feel how wrong this is going.

voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Calm breath before speaking; no rush to fill the silence.
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Offer Sunny a smaller, kinder definition of success.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [quietly] We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Gentle concern while steadying the ladder.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Hopeful, but aware she may not accept it.
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: We don’t need a perfect party, Sunny. We just need our friends.
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Protected hold after ladder steadies; about 3.0s.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Unhurried, grounded, a clear contrast to Sunny.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Brief pause after “Sunny” to let the thought reach her.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice supports Keen’s stillness; he becomes a safe anchor in the room.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Simple and balanced; the second sentence lands softer.
voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Keen
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: Please come back to us; we are already here.

voiceDirectorBrief.breaths: Audible quick inhale before “Well.”
voiceDirectorBrief.dramaticIntention: Make Keen stop soothing her and witness her prove she can fix it.
voiceDirectorBrief.elevenLabsV3Direction: [nervous] But I want it to be perfect! Well, I’ll make my own sunshine in here! Just watch!
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalEntry: Stung by Keen’s gentleness.
voiceDirectorBrief.emotionalExit: Defiant, performative, pushing forward again.
voiceDirectorBrief.exactDialogue: But I want it to be perfect! Well, I’ll make my own sunshine in here! Just watch!
voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: After Keen’s stillness has landed; about 4.0s, ending on forward action.
voiceDirectorBrief.pace: Starts with a sharp childlike spill, then flips into show-host brightness.
voiceDirectorBrief.pauses: Small emotional catch after “perfect!” before she chooses performance.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice reveals the crack under the wide smile, then snaps back into motion.
voiceDirectorBrief.rhythm: Hurt confession, forced reset, challenge.
voiceDirectorBrief.speaker: Sunny
voiceDirectorBrief.subtext: I heard you, but accepting that would mean admitting I failed.

geography: Fixed party geography: foreground party table with berry cups and napkins; Sunny crosses the midground; hanging garland and lanterns occupy the background; preserve the established table-side axis and layered depth across every cut.
invariants: Camera language of this world: Slightly imperfect and organic: breathing movement, gentle lens warmth, a steadicam or handheld feel for joyful, energetic sequences; a locked, still camera for moments of weight, emotion or revelation. Never clinical, never mechanical, never cold. Calm beat: stable, wide, breathing. Rising energy: closer lens, more movement, tighter frame. Emotional peak: the camera goes very still (weight) or very agitated (chaos). At the resolution beat the camera returns to wide, open and horizontal.

Light of this world: Warm golden-amber key (sun through the canopy, god-rays) against a cool green-teal fill from sky and ambient; that warm-gold against cool-teal contrast is the show's signature, with golden pollen scatter as warmth made visible. Never pure white light, never flat. Every light is motivated by something in the world (canopy sun, a crystal glow, a flower's warm reflection). A large soft source means warmth and belonging; a small hard source means tension or a secret. The key character gets the light; the secondary character gets the fill.

inputs.title: The Perfectly Rainy Party
inputs.logline: Sunny tries to save her perfect outdoor party from the rain, but only discovers real joy when she lets the soggy, muddy mess become the party her friends can share.

orderedEvents.text: A golden HONEYCOMB hangs from a branch. KEEN has built a catapult from sticks and a bendy branch. He loads a BERRY. Steps back. One eye closed. Tongue out. He lines up the shot — aiming carefully at the honeycomb. Nearby — ZENNY sits cross-legged on a leaf. Zenny meditates. Keen fires. WHOOSH — the berry flies — SPLAT. Right onto Zenny’s forehead. Juice slowly drips down. Keen ducks for cover and hides. Zenny’s eye twitches. She opens her eyes. Looks around. Sees — FUZZBY asleep on the honeycomb. Fuzzby snores, then awakens, laughing at Zenny. Zenny calmly licks the berry juice from her face. Closes her eyes again.

orderedEvents.speaker: Zenny
orderedEvents.text: OK, Fuzzby, calm down. It’s not that funny.

beats.storyBeat: Keen’s careful honeycomb scheme misfires immediately: the berry meant for the target lands on meditating Zenny, Fuzzby laughs from above, and Zenny restores her calm with dry restraint.
beats.want: Keen wants to prove his little invention can get the honeycomb.
beats.need: He needs to learn that cleverness without care affects his friends, not just the target.
beats.kidRead: A berry splats on the wrong face, Fuzzby laughs, and Zenny stays funny-calm.
beats.adultRead: A child’s private plan becomes social consequence; Zenny’s composure makes the chaos warmer instead of mean.
beats.emotionalIntent: Open with playful mischief, clean cause-and-effect, and character contrast: Keen’s eagerness, Fuzzby’s laughter, Zenny’s stillness.

orderedEvents.text: The forest is still. Morning light falls soft and golden through the trees. A pool sits quietly between the trees. AIDA sits beside it. Still. Peaceful. Eyes closed. Her ROSE QUARTZ PENDANT glows softly. The pool is perfectly still. In the water — an image appears. SUNNY. Arranging her perfect party. Garlands. Cups. That enormous smile. Aida watches the pool. Then — A single raindrop falls. Hits the surface right in the centre of Sunny’s reflection. The image ripples and breaks apart. Aida opens her eyes. Looks up at the sky. Dark clouds gathering. A long beat. Then back at the water.

orderedEvents.speaker: Aida
orderedEvents.text: Someone’s day might be a little dampened.
She rises quietly. Brushes herself down. Says nothing to anyone.

beats.adultRead: A caregiver sees trouble coming but can only witness and prepare, not prevent the child’s disappointment.

orderedEvents.text: Sunny climbs up the ladder holding a big, soaking wet string of yellow flowers. She grunts and pushes the wet garland onto the cave wall. It goes SQUISH. It is heavy and sad like a wet sponge. DRIP. DRIP. DRIP. Cold rainwater falls from the wet garland… right onto Keen’s head at the bottom of the ladder. Keen blinks. The water runs right down his nose. Sunny freezes, staring down at him. She gasps loudly, her eyes going wide.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Oh… no sunshine today? Just a drop? Instead of calming down, Sunny throws her hands in the air.

orderedEvents.speaker: Sunny
orderedEvents.text: Oh no! I’m making it rain inside! The party is getting wetter, not better! She lets go of the wet garland. It falls to the cave floor with a giant SPLAT! Muddy water splashes all over Keen’s toes.

orderedEvents.speaker: Misty
orderedEvents.text: Sunny, wait, it’s just a little water —
Keen looks down and wiggles his toes.

orderedEvents.speaker: Keen
orderedEvents.text: Actually… don’t worry! I love to splash in muddy puddles!
Keen gives a happy little STOMP. SPLASH!

orderedEvents.speaker: Sunny
orderedEvents.text: Muddy puddles?! At a perfect party?! No, no, no!

beats.storyBeat: Sunny hangs the soaking garland; it drips onto Keen, drops with a splat, and turns the cave floor into the exact muddy puddle play she cannot bear at a perfect party.
beats.want: Sunny wants the wet garland to become indoor sunshine.
beats.need: She needs to see that her friends can find joy in the mess she is rejecting.
beats.kidRead: The garland goes squish, rains on Keen, and makes a splashy puddle.
beats.adultRead: Keen’s playful acceptance exposes the gap between Sunny’s stated goal of fun and her fear of imperfect fun.
beats.emotionalIntent: Let physical mess challenge Sunny’s control through Keen’s opposite response.

orderedEvents.text: Ta-da! Everyone is having fun… Right?

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: I’m too sticky for this!
